note: QR-6 (P5.5) curated hymn alias — Edward Mote, 'The Solid Rock' / 'My Hope
Is Built on Nothing Less' (1834, public domain). Measured gap 2026-08-22
pre-change: 'the solid rock' #1 was Matthew 7:24 on passage_terms alone
(3.39 — no concept, no attribution); 'on christ the solid rock i stand'
led with a translation_variant accident; 'all other ground is sinking
sand' led with translation_variant noise (Acts 20:9, Eutychus 'sinking
down in a deep sleep').
Target: christ-the-cornerstone — the hymn's claim is christological
(Christ himself is the foundation of the sinner's hope; Mote's own title
is 'The Immutable Basis of a Sinner's Hope'), which is the cornerstone
locator's subject (1 Pet 2:4-7, Eph 2:19-22, Acts 4:11). Flagged J13
alternatives where two fit: building-on-the-rock (the wise/foolish
builders PARABLE supplies the sinking-sand imagery but is a claim about
hearing-and-doing, not about who Christ is) and hope-in-god (Heb 6:19's
anchor-of-the-soul). The alias mechanism deliberately does NOT add 'rock'
or 'foundation' to any lexicon — whole-query equality only — so the
cornerstone pack's G4 distinctness against building-on-the-rock is
untouched.
Written fixture-first (pending, failing); promoted in the 0.13.0 flip
commit that made it pass.
